messages:
Mina Patel: Quick thread to lock final onboarding + deprecation checklist for catalog entries. Need consensus on: artifact contract, hard vs soft gates, soft-pin windows, and emergency rollback semantics.

Omar Reyes: TL;DR I'd like a clear list: what blocks GA, what is a warn-only, and which checks are tenant-sensitive (EEA/KMS).

Mina Patel: Draft: HARD BLOCKS = zero-regression eval fail OR privacy flag missing OR embed schema incompatible. WARNINGS = cost delta up to +15%, small perf blips (<20% p95). Soft-pin default 14d for paid tenants, 4d for self-serve.

Claire Zhou: For zero-regression define: per-slice delta <= 1.0pp AND golden-query pass rate >= 99%. If one golden query mismatches -> block. Also require sample_embedding_hash match for embed models.

Devon Price: Rollout knobs: canary size default 5% or 10k reqs whichever first; canary duration 7 days. Auto-fallback if anomaly_rate >0.5% sustained 12m OR p95 > baseline+35% for 10m. Manual revert requires audit_id + human approver.

Mina Patel: Artifact must be machine-readable and immutable. Proposed keys (one-line): artifact_version, model, version, run_ts, slices_csv, quality_deltas_csv, regression_budget_pp, lat_p50_p95_p99_csv, cost_delta_pct, schema_hash, embed_schema_ok_bool, golden_queries_hash, smoke_pass_bool, privacy_review_id, kms_key_id, artifact_audit_id, blocking_reasons_csv. Location: s3://redwood-evals/<model>/<version>/<run_ts>/artifact.json

Omar Reyes: Infra note: prefer CSV arrays for simple rule engine. Also include tolerance_profile as CSV aligned with slices so infra can evaluate per-slice p95 thresholds without lookup.

Claire Zhou: Add "grace_override" field that records business-approval ticket id and approver for cases where cost trade is accepted (e.g., +20% cost but +3pp quality). Must surface in Console.

Devon Price: Ops asks: API endpoints we need up front: POST /inspectArtifact(path) -> {pass|fail, blocking_reasons}, POST /rollouts/{id}/pause, POST /rollouts/{id}/revert with revert_reason. Rollout controller should log artifact_audit_id with any action.

ops-bot: CI: bench queued for model "cedar-experimental-4" job=bmk-3123459999-A ETA ~2h.

Mina Patel: Deprecation flow: 30-day notice for paid tenants, 7-day notice for self-serve; exemptions handled case-by-case with migration_plan attached to artifact. When retiring a pinned model require either (a) compatibility shim in place OR (b) per-tenant migration opt-in recorded. Record retire_notice_ts in artifact.

Omar Reyes: For pinned swaps add a soft rollback window: after global swap, auto-monitor 30d; if regression signal appears in first 72h revert automatically if anomaly rules exceed thresholds.

Claire Zhou: Compliance: EEA tenants must have privacy_review_id and kms_key_id present or the artifact is a hard block. Also retention: artifact immutable + stored 180 days for audits.

Devon Price: UX: Console should show lane (low/med/high risk), soft-pin countdown, blocking_reasons, artifact link, and a one-click "request override" that creates a ticket and appends approval to artifact. Ops needs ack_id returned.

Mina Patel: Next steps: I'll draft a short spec doc with example artifact files and the exact CSV order today. Infra (Omar) will prototype rule engine next sprint. Ops (Devon) will draft API stubs and UI wireframe. Legal/compliance to review privacy/KMS gating. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
